label: SIMULATED MODEL RESPONSES — Analyst drafts for the real frozen Coinbase PDF

claims.anchor: At the end of Q4 we had $9.3 billion in $USD resources
claims.text: Coinbase reported $9.3 billion in $USD resources at the end of Q4 2024; this company-defined measure includes cash and cash equivalents and net USDC.

claims.anchor: Our $USD resources increased $1.1 billion Q/Q or 13%
claims.text: Coinbase stated that its $USD resources increased $1.1 billion quarter over quarter in Q4 2024.

claims.anchor: USDC (net of USDC loaned or pledged as collateral)
claims.text: The disclosed $USD resources measure should not be treated as cash alone because it also includes net USDC; these disclosures alone do not establish a final liquidity risk level.

claims.anchor: a district court granted our request for interlocutory appeal
claims.text: Coinbase reported that a district court granted its request for interlocutory appeal in January 2025 in its ongoing SEC litigation.

claims.anchor: Discovery is paused pending the outcome of this process
claims.text: Coinbase stated that discovery was paused pending the outcome of the interlocutory appeal process; this is a company disclosure, not an independent legal finding.
